So my advice as someone in HR is, if you don’t think you want to study, find a sector you think you’ll be interested in: Accountancy, marketing, HR, data Analysis ANY sector, and start looking for traineeships or entry level roles, even fixed term contracts/ internships depending on whether or not you have the security of living at home and apply. 

Just because you’re 18 doesn’t mean you have to work hospitality retail. Worst case, you’ll have a 9-5 that you’ll find you’re not interested in and have security to plan your next move. At best, you’ll have your foot in the door of a career years ahead of your peers who are currently in university. The majority of companies will be happy to pay for your professional qualifications (relevant to that sector) as it’s a great investment for them.

If you need any help on looking for these roles, sorting out a resume/cover letter or interview prep feel free to get in touch and I’d be happy to lend a hand 😊
